flyer.justification: The flyer is well-formatted and captures the essence of the talk, but the title slightly exceeds the maximum word count of 6 words.

instagram.justification: The post perfectly adheres to all format instructions including carousel cues, emojis, call to action, and the required hashtag count.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all length and formatting requirements with three distinct bold sections, strong editorial flow, and a subject line under 50 characters.

linkedin.justification: The post is well-written without cliches, but it completely omitted the required 3-5 hashtags.

summary.justification: The summary provides an excellent, concise executive briefing under 400 words with all required structural sections.

blog.justification: The blog post comprehensively covers almost all key points from the talk and fulfills every structural requirement including the comparison table and author profile.
